Describe the trip in your own words. Vero shortlists real, live fares and never a made-up price.

Try asking

Plan the rest

Flights are just the start

StaysHotels worldwide, priced liveExploreExperiencesTours and activities at your destinationExplore

Questions

Good to know before you book

Are the prices real?

Yes. Fares come live from our airline and distribution partners when you search. If a fare changes before you pay, we show the new total first.

When do I pay?

Only after you review travellers and the full total. Nothing is charged before that, and payment is handled securely by our payment partner.

How long is a fare held?

Once you select a flight, the fare is held for a short time while you check out. A countdown on the payment page shows how long is left.

When do I get my ticket?

Your confirmation arrives by email once the airline issues the e-ticket.

Can I book for more than one traveller?

Yes. Add up to nine adults, choose your cabin, and enter each traveller's details at checkout.

Which currencies can I pay in?

Choose your currency in the header. Fares and totals are shown in it wherever the supplier allows.

Questions

Good to know before you book

Are the prices real?

Yes. Fares come live from our airline and distribution partners when you search. If a fare changes before you pay, we show the new total first.

When do I pay?

Only after you review travellers and the full total. Nothing is charged before that, and payment is handled securely by our payment partner.

How long is a fare held?

Once you select a flight, the fare is held for a short time while you check out. A countdown on the payment page shows how long is left.

When do I get my ticket?

Your confirmation arrives by email once the airline issues the e-ticket.

Can I book for more than one traveller?

Yes. Add up to nine adults, choose your cabin, and enter each traveller's details at checkout.

Which currencies can I pay in?

Choose your currency in the header. Fares and totals are shown in it wherever the supplier allows.

Flights Hotels Experiences Vero
Sign in

Account Travel DNA Trips

Tours, packages & activities

Don’t just see the world. Feel it.

Explore the world

Find the day you want

Kind, city, or region, then a live tour. No filler listings.

Destinations

Near you first, then the rest of the world.

Multi-day circuits

Safari, trek, cruise, high pass worldwide, your region first.

Complete the city

Hop-on, city passes, and full-day days in one ticket.

Extraordinary experiences

Live tours, one pick per city

Highest-reviewed singles from inventory. We do not invent a ranking.

Booking confidence

Live price. Your hold. Then you pay.

Same checkout as hotels. We never invent a fare or book without you.

  1. Search live inventory City, dates, guests, then the real list.
  2. Read the day Photos, inclusions, reviews, and upcoming dates.
  3. Hold, then pay A short hold on the live slot, then pay securely.
  4. Wait for the voucher Payment first. Then the supplier confirms.

Plan the rest

The day is only one part of the trip

FlightsLive fares into the city you just opened Explore StaysHotels with live nightly rates, never a brochure price Explore

Questions

Good to know before you book the day

Are experience prices real?

Yes. Prices come live from Experiences inventory for your dates and guests. If a rate changes before you pay, we show the new total first. We never invent a deal or discount badge.

When do I pay?

Only after you pick a live slot, review travellers, and confirm the hold. Nothing is charged before that; payment is handled securely by our payment partner.

What does “from / person” mean?

It is the lowest live adult price we have for that tour in your currency when the supplier provides one. If we do not have a priced slot yet, we show “See details”, never a made-up amount.

Which currencies can I pay in?

Choose your currency in the header. Totals use it wherever the supplier allows; otherwise we show the supplier currency and a clear notice.

Do photos guarantee the exact day?

No. Photos show the experience. Inclusions, meeting point, and open dates are confirmed on the live tour detail before you hold.

Can Vero book for me?

Vero shortlists live tours from inventory. She does not invent a price or complete a booking without you.
